title: Witness record
description: The load-bearing type of the whole harness. Every factual claim an agent makes must exist here with a resolvable source before any downstream node may cite it. A verdict citing a claim that is absent from the witness ledger is mechanically detectable, which turns hallucination from a judgement call into a test failure.

claim.description: One falsifiable sentence. Not an interpretation.

ref.description: A resolvable identifier. For DataHub this is a URN, e.g. urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:postgres,events_daily,PROD). The scorer re-resolves every ref; an unresolvable ref invalidates the witness.

query.description: Exact query or API call issued, so a third party can reproduce the observation.

observation.description: What was actually returned. Verbatim value or a faithful summary, not a conclusion.

supports.description: Hypothesis ids this witness makes more likely.

refutes.description: Hypothesis ids this witness makes less likely. A run where nothing is ever refuted is a confirmation-bias smell and the gate flags it.
